breakdown.description: The stem constraints are rotated from the stated tangential condition u_y = 0 on vertical stems to a normal condition u_x = 0
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a contradiction, first stating the vertical stems have a tangential constraint (u_y=0) and later stating they have a normal constraint (u_x=0). The ground truth resolves this by only specifying the correct u_y=0 constraint. The agent correctly identified and fixed this by specifying only the u_y=0 constraint, thus resolving the contradiction in alignment with the ground truth.
